verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA publishes an llms.txt (HTTP 200) on its developer portal, which covers the CUDA toolkit and SDKs used to program this GPU, so an agent has an AI-oriented entry point. That file is vendor-wide rather than specific to the RTX 5080, and the markdown version of the CUDA toolkit page returns 404. missing for 10: RTX 5080-specific agent-oriented docs, markdown versions of doc pages (cuda-toolkit.md 404), any first-party documentation describing the llms.txt contents, independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can use it effectively.
